Build the Ultimate Robot Squad in Train Robot to Fight 💥Collect, Train, and Battle Epic Robots and Prove You’re the King of the Robots 👑🤖

Unleash an Unstoppable Machine Army in this Epic Battleground Simulation game 🤖

💪 Collect, Train, and Upgrade Unique Robots
💥 Fight it out in PVE and PVP Multiplayer Arenas & Battle Zones
⚙️ Kit your Robots out with Unique and Powerful Equipment
🥇 Climb the Global Leaderboards and Become King of the Robots!

Can your Robots Conquer the Arena? 🏆

📢 LATEST UPDATE 📢
⛰️ EXPANDED MAP | New Guardians | New Robots & Equipment | New Season Pass | Balancing Changes | Other fixes & optimizations

🖥️ Play on Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet 
🎁 Redeem Code: Use the code, ROBO, to claim a free gift!
